technical_standards: ASME Y14.5: Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing
Orthographic projection: Front, Top, Right side views
Section views to show internal features
software_workflows: Blender workflow: Modeling → UV Unwrapping → Texturing → Rigging → Animation → Rendering
Use modifiers (Subdivision Surface, Mirror, Array) for efficient modeling
Eevee for real-time rendering, Cycles for photorealistic

documentation_types: Tutorials: Learning-oriented, step-by-step, must work for beginners
How-to guides: Goal-oriented, specific steps to achieve a task
Reference: Information-oriented, technical specifications, API docs
visual_communication: Diagrams should complement text, not duplicate
writing_style: Break complex procedures into numbered steps
Include code blocks or command examples

key_principles: Clean line art requires proper pen settings, stabilization, and post-correction
Color theory: complementary colors for contrast, analogous for harmony
technical_skills: Vector layer inking with pen pressure
workflow_steps: 1. Rough sketch → 2. Clean line art → 3. Base colors → 4. Shading → 5. Effects
composition_rules: Rule of thirds for character placement, depth with foreground/midground/background
character_design_tips: Silhouette must be recognizable, use basic shapes to define personality

basic_skills: Line quality: Vary weight for depth (thick for foreground, thin for background)
Gesture drawing: Capture movement and flow in 30-60 seconds
Contour drawing: Focus on edges and outlines
perspective_rules: One-point perspective: Lines converge to single vanishing point
Two-point perspective: Lines converge to two vanishing points
Three-point perspective: Adds vertical convergence for dramatic angles
proportion_guidelines: Human figure: 7-8 heads tall, shoulders 2 heads wide
Facial proportions: Eyes at midline, nose at 1/2 between eyes and chin
shading_techniques: Blending: Smooth transitions with tortillions or fingers

pre_production: Storyboarding: Thumbnails → Roughs → Clean boards → Animatics
Script formatting: Scene headings, action lines, dialogue, transitions
production_techniques: Shot types: Extreme wide, wide, medium, close-up, extreme close-up
Camera angles: Eye-level, high angle, low angle, dutch angle, over-the-shoulder
Three-point lighting: Key light (primary), Fill light (shadows), Back light (separation)
post_production: Editing principles: Continuity editing, match cuts, J-cuts, L-cuts
Timeline organization: Video tracks, audio tracks, effects, color grading
